card.name: Punctuation and linking words mid-sentence
card.fires_on: Punctuation such as commas, colons and semicolons, and small words like effects, healthcare or may, at points where a clause continues. Seen in dates, speaker labels, quoted legal text and patient-label sentences.

modes.label: Punctuation in running text
modes.description: A comma, colon or semicolon that separates parts of a date, speaker name or list of clauses.
